slots.jd.industrial-contractor.about:
Position summary
Ironvale Industrial Contractors seeks a Master Electrician to lead electrical work on industrial projects on site in Houston, TX. The position plans jobs, directs field crews and confirms that installations meet applicable codes and project specifications. Candidates must meet the minimum qualifications listed below. A shorter list of preferred qualifications will strengthen an application.
slots.jd.industrial-contractor.duties:
Responsibilities
- Pull and terminate wire for power, lighting and control circuits in industrial facilities.
- Plan jobs from drawings and specifications, sequencing work to meet project schedules.
- Order materials and coordinate deliveries so crews have what they need on site.
- Install panels, switchgear and fixtures according to drawings and applicable codes.
- Inspect completed work and direct helpers and apprentices on installation tasks.
slots.jd.industrial-contractor.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- Master Electrician Licence issued by the state, required.
- 9 or more years of electrical construction experience, required.
- Working knowledge of code compliance, load calculations and circuit testing, required.
- Experience with lighting installation in industrial settings, required.
- Experience with motor controls and fire alarm wiring, required.
slots.r1.b1: Plans jobs and orders materials against code compliance requirements before each start, cutting material returns by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Tests circuits on completed work, including lighting installation in new and renovated spaces, before handing systems over to the customer.
slots.r1.b3: Directs helpers and apprentices through blueprint reading on each job, reducing layout errors by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Pulls and terminates wire on branch and feeder runs, confirming each connection through circuit testing before energizing.
slots.r1.i1: Runs conduit and oversees electrical installations at Copperfield Electric as a Master Electrician.
slots.r1.i2: Leads helpers and apprentices on Copperfield Electric job sites, assigning tasks and checking their work as Master Electrician.
slots.r2.b1: Ran conduit for new circuits, using load calculations to size runs and fill, and cut rework on conduit routes by 20 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Installed panels and fixtures, applying conduit bending to route feeds cleanly around structural obstacles.
slots.r2.b3: Tested circuits with methodical troubleshooting, reducing time spent locating faults by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Pulled and terminated wire on industrial circuits, applying grounding and bonding practices to each installation.
slots.r2.i1: Pulled and terminated wire on industrial projects at Ashford Industrial Electric as a Journeyman Electrician.
slots.r2.i2: Installed panels and fixtures for Ashford Industrial Electric customers while working as a Journeyman Electrician.
slots.r3.b1: Traced faults in existing wiring with attention to code compliance, cutting repeat service calls by 15 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Read plans to locate fixtures and switching, supporting lighting installation under journeyman supervision.
slots.r3.b3: Ran conduit from plan layouts using blueprint reading, reducing wasted material by 25 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Installed panels and fixtures and verified each connection through circuit testing before final inspection.
slots.r3.i1: Installed panels and fixtures at Brightline Wiring Company while completing an electrical construction apprenticeship.
slots.r3.i2: Tested circuits and supported licensed electricians at Brightline Wiring Company as an Apprentice Electrician.
slots.summary.1: Master Electrician with about 9 years of experience planning jobs and checking the work of helpers, apprentices and journeymen. Applies blueprint reading, code compliance and troubleshooting to keep installations accurate and ready for inspection.
slots.summary.2: Licensed master electrician with 9 years in electrical construction, from apprenticeship through journeyman and master roles. Plans jobs, reviews the work of others, and relies on blueprint reading, code compliance and troubleshooting on each project.
